title: Magento 1 chatbot: the read-only shape that survives
lede: A client wants a chatbot bolted onto a 2017 Magento 1 store. The trick is keeping it read-only, off the checkout path, and out of the order tables.
hero_alt: Overhead bone-linen desk with inked Magento blueprint, manila folder, index cards, brass plate, wax seal, fountain pen.
